attributes.name: Defiant Nodachi +3
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d10+3; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d10. If this is your first combat check of the turn, add another 1d6. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. 

After discarding or burying this card as damage, draw it.
